newsitem.title: USA: Ocean Energy sees Q2 output 43,000 boepd.
newsitem.headline: Ocean Energy sees Q2 output 43,000 boepd.

text.p: Ocean Energy Inc expects its net average hydrocarbon production to be over 43,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day (boepd) in the second quarter.
Current net production is 45,000 boepd. Barrels of oil equivalent are calculated by dividing thousand cubic feet of gas by six and adding that amount to liquids production.

The company said that three new fields and projects in the Delta and central Gulf of Mexico are scheduled to begin production in the third and fourth quarters of 1997, at a combined net rate of 10,000 to 15,000 boepd. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
